verdict.rationale: Maritime hosts Swagger UI over its live OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.maritime.sh/docs, which supports in-page request execution against the real API with a bearer key, so an interactive, runnable reference exists. It is the raw FastAPI-generated spec, though, and the prose docs offer only copyable curl examples with no embedded runner. missing for 10: curated runnable examples in the main docs (an embedded runner rather than curl-only), a polished public-only reference without internal host-events paths, independent or hands-on corroboration that try-it-out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API origin hosts Swagger UI over the live spec ("Maritime API - Swagger UI", loading /openapi.json), with in-page request execution against the real API using a bearer key
The prose docs carry copyable curl examples rather than an embedded runner.
The document is the raw FastAPI-generated spec and includes internal host-events paths alongside the public surface.
